messages.subject: precision of a "copy" model
parts:
Hi all,

when using the copy-feature, the degree of closeness between copied
terms is determined by the argument "precision" [1].
Now, is this a parameter of the model over which inference is made? If
so, where are the priors defined and posteriors returned?
Or, is it fixed? If so, what is its default value?

Thanks!
ƒacu.-


[1] http://www.r-inla.org/models/tools#TOC-Copying-a-model
